name: GenHome3D model benches
note: Each bench builds one reference image with more than one model. Attribution is copied from the metadata recorded at build time, and review states are reported as the library sealed them.

audit.reviewer: Claude Opus 5. No person looked at these builds.
audit.method: Each build's reference, hero render and reverse render were compared. Every candidate defect was then re-examined by a second reviewer told to refute it; 61 were raised and 60 survived. Camera, lighting, texture detail and simplified ornament were out of scope.

benches.brief: Capsule plan with continuous pale birch bars, rounded ends, a fitted oval mattress, and four splayed legs.
observations: In the picture the mattress rests on a ring inside the bars. GPT-5.6 Sol used a rectangular mattress that pushes past the oval; Claude Opus 5 shaped the mattress to the oval and sat it on a slatted base.

GPT-5.6 Sol used fewer, thicker bars. Claude Opus 5 counted 46 bars off the picture at 77 mm apart, which keeps every gap under the 60 mm limit for a crib.
